source: Thomsen et al. 2020, accepted manuscript, DOI 10.1007/s10694-019-00866-0, p10 Eq6; https://ira.lib.polyu.edu.hk/bitstream/10397/89518/1/43_FT_2020_Buoyancy_Rod.pdf
transform: U_m = 100 * [(U_f_cms/100)^4 + (9.80665*g_fraction*kappa*diameter_mm/2000)^2]^(1/4), cm/s. This is the Eq6 P/P0=1 special case. Radius, not diameter, is the characteristic length. kappa=beta*DeltaT is assumed constant, not measured or fitted.
assumptions: Pressure-normalized hypothesis: no per-row pressure or temperature is imputed into the dataset. Treating recorded flow as reference-pressure flow and g as nominal0/1 are model assumptions. This tests a conditional feature map, not a complete pressure-aware combustion solver. kappa3.5 comes from roadmap p2 illustration;1 and5.2 are declared sensitivity scenarios, not confidence bounds or source-calibrated constants. No universal lunar speed asserted.
fit: Group-weighted log-target ridge, alpha1, weighted train-only feature standardization. Loss=sum(w*(ln(y)-prediction)^2)+sum(b^2)+lambda*n*mean(relu(-D*b)^2). D rows are sigma_O2*d(log_prediction)/d(O2) at min/max TRAINING ln(U). D=[sigma_O2/scale0,0,0,sigma_O2*ln(U)/scale3]. Intercept unpenalized. Enumerate four possible active sets of two convex squared-hinge constraints, solve normal equations on CUDA float64, require sign consistency and stationarity. This is a soft oxygen-direction prior over the training U interval, not a PDE residual, global monotonic guarantee, or calibrated physical bound. No flow/gravity monotonicity assumed.
gpu: PyTorch CUDA on user's Blackwell, no CPU fallback for five regression variants; CPU NumPy used for data preparation, median/nearest baselines and independent verification. Small linear solves are not expected to benefit in speed.
splits: Reuse all37 Round1 splits unchanged. Add30 pooled leave-group-out folds across69 rows and25 pooled strict-unit folds across58 rows (exclude11 U01 flight rows, including from training). Groups never cross train/test. Report pooled Earth and flight scores separately. No split or model tuning based on Round3 outcomes.
baselines: Recompute group-weighted median and raw-feature standardized nearest lookup on identical folds. Geometry control must reproduce Round2 log_geometry_ridge on original37 splits. Pooled baseline learns from both domains and cannot substitute for Earth-only transfer.
primary_metric: Equal-group MAE mm/s; also group RMSE, row R2. Predictions are exp(log prediction), no clipping or smearing.
primary_comparison: Earth-only mixed_3p5_penalty versus same-fold nearest baseline and geometry_control. Report transform-only and penalty incremental effects separately. All sensitivity results remain visible; no winner selection by ISS score.
gates: Report user's exploratory gate MAE<nearest (~0.01662348), plus retained20% improvement gate MAE<=0.8*nearest (~0.01329879). Neither is task-based safety acceptance. Report paired group bootstrap2000 resamples as descriptive sensitivity, not confirmatory inference.
limits: ISS labels and prior results have already been seen, making this reused development evaluation, not blind confirmation. Source physics itself used BASS-II, potentially overlapping these rows; constants/correlations fitted to those ISS outcomes are not imported. No new real labels; no compatible partial-g opposed-black-rod rate test accepted. No lunar accuracy, certified mode, probability of winning, or scientific impossibility inference from failure.
stop: Finish fixed Round3, independent verification, all-results localhost review and research handoff; stop for user review. No autonomous Round4 or final deployment model. No synthetic labels, no source deletion, no pressure scenarios outside observed support.
